name: @amlhubs/nif
description: NIF 2.0 — NLP Interchange Format. W3C BP-MLOD Community Group / persistence.uni-leipzig.org. RDF/OWL ontology providing a substring-offset URI scheme (RFC 5147 #char=begin,end) for interoperable interchange of NLP annotations across tools, plus the nif-core class hierarchy (Context / String / Word / Phrase / Sentence / Title / Paragraph / Annotation) and the offset/anchor/superString/subString/nextWord/previousWord property surface. Authority caveat: academic hosting at Leipzig (AKSW/InfAI), no chartered W3C WG — see README §Authority.
